feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 27 October 2026 10:41pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 27 October 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds until later tomorrow.


##Synopsis##

High pressure near the Azores and a deep area of low pressure to the north of Scotland.


##Wind##

Southwest 6 or 7, decreasing West or Southwest 5 or 6 tomorrow morning, 4 or 5 in the afternoon, then 3 or 4 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming moderate tomorrow morning, then slight in the evening.


##Weather##

Fair, then a few outbreaks of rain and drizzle developing for a time.


##Visibility##

Mainly good, falling moderate or poor in rain and drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, backing South overnight into Thursday, then increasing South or Southeast 4 or 5 on Thursday morning and afternoon, occasionally 6 in the west of area.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair, then patchy drizzle for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in any drizzle.
